title: TeaCollection
description: The collection of one published release: the versioned set of artifacts (SBOMs, VEX documents, attestations) TEA serves for it. TEA gives a collection the UUID of its release, so a collection exists only for a release a CI pipeline has already published, and plan fails until it has been. Declaring the collection makes sure it exists and gives a TeaAccessPolicy something to name, such as an embargo on one release. The artifacts are runtime data: CI adds them, and each addition moves the collection's version on, which status reports and which is not a change to this document. A collection this document creates starts at version 1 with the update reason INITIAL_RELEASE; one CI created first is adopted as it is. Removing the document deletes the collection while it has never held an artifact; otherwise the collection stays with its release and only the config management of it ends.

product.description: The metadata.name of a TeaProduct, for the collection of one of its product releases.

component.description: The metadata.name of a TeaComponent, for the collection of one of its component releases.

release.description: The release's version, exactly as CI published it, such as 2.4.0.
